output.summary: An annual herb native to Europe and Western Asia, Mediterranean hartwort has softly hairy, divided leaves and white flowers with enlarged, deeply two-lobed petals. Its round, flattened fruit is elaborately textured. The leaves are eaten in Greece as a cooked green and salad vegetable, while in Italy the plant is used as a condiment.
